newsitem.title: UK: UK's Rugby Group buys Boulton and Paul.
newsitem.headline: UK's Rugby Group buys Boulton and Paul.

text.p: British building materials company the Rugby Group Plc said on Tuesday it had bought British joinery manufacturer Boulton and Paul (Holdings) Ltd for an initial payment of 15.5 million pounds.

The Rugby Group said in a statement the deal provided for deferred payments dependent on future profits of the combined joinery businesses of Bolton and Paul and Rugby's John Carr. The company said the upper limit on the deferred payments was 34.5 million pounds.
Boulton and Paul's net operating assets were valued at 21 million pounds excluding debt in March 1996, the company said.
